challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.p1: Traditional surveillance systems suffer from high latency and significant false alarm rates. In high-security environments, the gap between an incident and its detection can be catastrophic.
challenge.p2: The core challenge was to engineer a pipeline capable of processing multiple 4K video streams simultaneously. This required maintaining a sub-15ms inference time per frame while achieving over 98% precision in diverse lighting conditions, from harsh midday sun to low-light night environments.
